questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells drivers that a winding road is coming. Slow down and be ready for curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Stay to the right side of the divider ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed at one-way streets and ramps. It means you cannot drive in this direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No turns are allowed on this road.
There are a series of curves ahead.
The road may be slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: There are a series of curves ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a winding road with three or more curves ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign marks a low ground railroad crossing. The tracks are at a steep slope, and low vehicles may scrape the bottom or get stuck on the tracks.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep hill is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A flagger is ahead controlling traffic in a construction area. Follow their directions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Parking spaces are reserved for people with disabled parking permits.
Traffic in the lane must turn in the direction of the arrow.
Lanes are reserved for buses and vehicles with a driver and one or more passengers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Parking spaces are reserved for people with disabled parking permits.
questions.explanation: These parking spaces are reserved only for people who have disabled parking permits.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The maximum safe speed for a residential area.
The maximum safe speed for an expressway exit.
The maximum safe speed for an expressway entrance.
The maximum safe speed for a work zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe speed for an expressway exit.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the safe speed limit for exiting a highway. In this example, the safe speed is 30 mph.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: When riding in a group, the lead rider extends their left arm straight out with palm up, then swings their arm upward. This signal means all riders should increase their speed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The highway ahead curves only to the right.
The highway ahead turns sharply to the right.
The highway ahead curves to the right and then to the left.
The highway ahead curves to the left and then to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway ahead curves to the right and then to the left.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you the road curves to the right first, then to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Trucks are permitted on an upcoming narrow bridge.
The bridge ahead is open to one-way traffic only.
The bridge ahead is wide enough for only one car at a time.
The bridge ahead may be too narrow to meet or pass a truck.

questions.correctAnswerText: The bridge ahead may be too narrow to meet or pass a truck.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you the bridge ahead is too narrow. You may not be able to pass a truck on this bridge. Drive carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign prohibits U-turns.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are approaching.

questions.explanation: This sign marks a bicycle crossing or path. Slow down and watch for bicycles in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Highway changes ahead and to the right.
Hiking trails ahead and to the right.
Hotel ahead and to the right.
Hospital ahead and to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Hospital ahead and to the right.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you a hospital with emergency services is located to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Lane reduction; the right lane ends soon.
Lane reduction; the left lane ends soon.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane reduction; the right lane ends soon.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the right lane is ending soon.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.
Drive with caution and be ready to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. Come to a complete stop and make sure the way is clear before you go.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign prohibits right turns.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: When a lead rider extends their left arm straight out with palm down and swings it down to their side, it signals following riders to slow down.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign marks a pedestrian crossing. Watch for people crossing and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a road crossing ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns that a sharp turn is coming. Slow down to stay safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Don't drink if you are going to drive.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: May either continue through the interchange or exit the freeway from your current lane.
May stay in your lane and continue through the interchange.
Must exit the freeway, if you stay in your current lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must exit the freeway, if you stay in your current lane.
questions.explanation: An "Exit only" sign means the lane below it will exit the freeway. You cannot continue straight in that lane. You must either change lanes to go through the interchange or exit the freeway.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with yellow backgrounds and black markings. They alert you to dangers ahead. This sign warns that wet pavement ahead is slippery. Drive carefully because your vehicle may be harder to control.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The traffic signal ahead is displaying a red light.
The traffic signal ahead is broken.
The traffic signal ahead is displaying a green light.
There is a traffic signal ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic signal ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign alerts you that a traffic signal is coming at the next intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs enforce traffic rules that drivers must obey. This sign means you cannot park here.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must turn left or right.
You are approaching a T intersection.
The road that you are on intersects with a divided highway.
You are on an overpass above a divided highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road that you are on intersects with a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign means your road is crossing a divided highway. A divided highway has two separate one-way roads separated by a median or barrier.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a divided highway is starting ahead. The road splits into two one-way roads separated by a median. Stay to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep hill is coming ahead.
